# Fortune
> Fortune is a global business media publication covering companies, markets, leadership, technology, and influential rankings.

Fortune publishes breaking business news, analysis, executive reporting, and signature lists including the Fortune 500 and Global 500. Its coverage spans finance, tech, policy, careers, and regional business developments, with dedicated sections for rankings, leadership communities, and newsletters.

## Core News Sections
- [Home](https://fortune.com/): Front page for Fortune’s latest business news, features, rankings, and analysis.
- [Latest](https://fortune.com/section/latest/): Most recent stories across business, markets, technology, politics, and leadership.
- [News](https://fortune.com/section/news/): General business news coverage spanning companies, policy, and the global economy.
- [Finance](https://fortune.com/section/finance/): Reporting on markets, investing, banking, deals, and economic developments.
- [Tech](https://fortune.com/section/tech/): Coverage of technology companies, AI, startups, and digital industry trends.
- [Leadership](https://fortune.com/section/leadership/): Reporting on CEOs, management, workplace strategy, and corporate leadership.
- [Retail](https://fortune.com/section/retail/): News and analysis on consumer brands, commerce, and retail companies.
- [Well](https://fortune.com/well/): Coverage focused on health, wellness, work-life, and personal well-being.

## Rankings and Lists
- [Fortune 500](https://fortune.com/ranking/fortune500/): Annual ranking of the largest U.S. companies by revenue.
- [Global 500](https://fortune.com/ranking/global500/): Annual ranking of the world’s largest corporations by revenue.
- [Fortune 500 Europe](https://fortune.com/europe/ranking/fortune500-europe/): Ranking of Europe’s largest companies by revenue.
- [Southeast Asia 500](https://fortune.com/asia/ranking/southeast-asia-500/): Ranking of the biggest companies across Southeast Asia.
- [100 Best Companies to Work For](https://fortune.com/ranking/best-companies/): Annual workplace ranking highlighting top employers in the United States.
- [Most Powerful Women](https://fortune.com/ranking/most-powerful-women/): Fortune’s ranking and coverage of influential women in business.
- [Change the World](https://fortune.com/ranking/change-the-world/): List recognizing companies making measurable social or environmental impact.
- [World’s Most Admired Companies](https://fortune.com/ranking/worlds-most-admired-companies/): Ranking of companies with strong reputations across industries.

## Fortune 500 and Ranking Coverage
- [Fortune 500 Section](https://fortune.com/section/fortune-500/): News, analysis, and updates related to Fortune 500 companies and rankings.
- [Global 500 Section](https://fortune.com/section/global-500/): Reporting and commentary tied to the Global 500 list.
- [MPW Section](https://fortune.com/section/mpw/): Stories, interviews, and event coverage related to Most Powerful Women.
- [Best Companies Section](https://fortune.com/section/best-companies/): Coverage of workplace culture, employee experience, and top employers.
- [CEO Initiative](https://fortune.com/ceo-initiative/): Executive-focused reporting and community content for chief executives.

## Topic Coverage
- [AI](https://fortune.com/section/ai/): News and analysis on artificial intelligence, models, regulation, and adoption.
- [Markets](https://fortune.com/section/markets/): Coverage of stock markets, trading, investor sentiment, and market-moving events.
- [Investing](https://fortune.com/section/investing/): Reporting on investment strategy, asset classes, and investor behavior.
- [Crypto](https://fortune.com/crypto/): News and features on cryptocurrency, blockchain, and digital asset markets.
- [Energy](https://fortune.com/section/energy/): Coverage of oil, gas, renewables, utilities, and energy transition issues.
- [Real Estate](https://fortune.com/section/real-estate/): Reporting on housing, commercial property, and real estate markets.
- [Careers](https://fortune.com/section/careers/): Stories on jobs, hiring, workplace trends, and career development.
- [Success](https://fortune.com/section/success/): Advice and reporting on work, money, productivity, and professional growth.

## Regional Coverage
- [Europe](https://fortune.com/section/europe/): Business news and analysis focused on Europe’s companies, markets, and policy.
- [Asia](https://fortune.com/section/asia/): Coverage of Asian business, trade, geopolitics, and regional economies.
- [Middle East](https://fortune.com/section/middle-east/): Reporting on business, finance, and economic developments in the Middle East.
- [North America](https://fortune.com/section/north-america/): News and analysis centered on the U.S., Canada, and regional business trends.

## Leadership, Work, and Community
- [Fortune Well](https://fortune.com/well/): Health, wellness, and lifestyle reporting for professionals and leaders.
- [Fortune Education](https://fortune.com/education/): Coverage of higher education, business school, and career-oriented learning.
- [Fortune Recommends](https://fortune.com/recommends/): Consumer finance and product recommendation content from Fortune editors.
- [Fortune Connect](https://fortune.com/connect/): Membership and community-oriented content for business leaders and readers.

## Newsletters and Audio
- [Newsletters](https://fortune.com/newsletters/): Directory of Fortune email newsletters across business, markets, and leadership topics.
- [Podcasts](https://fortune.com/podcasts/): Fortune podcast hub featuring interviews, analysis, and business storytelling.
- [Video](https://fortune.com/video/): Video reporting, interviews, and explainers on major business stories.

## Events and Conferences
- [Fortune Events](https://fortune.com/events/): Hub for Fortune conferences, summits, and live business events.
- [Most Powerful Women Summit](https://fortune.com/franchise-list/most-powerful-women/): Event and franchise coverage for Fortune’s MPW community.
- [Brainstorm Tech](https://fortune.com/franchise-list/brainstorm-tech/): Coverage and event content focused on technology and innovation leaders.
- [CEO Initiative](https://fortune.com/ceo-initiative/): Executive community and event platform for CEOs and senior leaders.

## About and Corporate
- [About Fortune](https://fortune.com/about/): Overview of Fortune, its mission, editorial focus, and brand.
- [Editorial Calendar](https://fortune.com/editorial-calendar/): Planned editorial themes, franchises, and publishing opportunities.
- [Customer Service](https://fortune.com/customer-service/): Subscription, account, and support information for readers.
- [Terms of Use](https://fortune.com/terms-of-use/): Legal terms governing use of Fortune’s website and services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://fortune.com/privacy-policy/): Information on data collection, privacy practices, and user rights.
